title: Move main bottom navigation into TasksDrawer while keeping SubjectsBar fixed

requirements.summary: Remove the main route button row from the fixed bottom bar and keep SubjectsBar as the only persistent bottom element.
acceptanceCriteria: The fixed bottom bar no longer shows the Home/Calendar/Countdown/Notes/Tests button row.
The fixed bottom bar still shows the existing SubjectsBar with the same subject switching/add/delete behavior.
All routes and navigation destinations for Home (/), Calendar (/calendar), Countdown (/countdown), Notes (/notes), and Tests (/tests) remain available via the menu drawer.
Active route styling/affordance is preserved in the new menu entries (the currently active route is visually indicated).

file_operations.description: Update BottomNavigation to render only the fixed SubjectsBar (remove the main navItems button row and any now-unused routing/icon/button code), ensuring the SubjectsBar remains visible as the sole fixed bottom element outside the drawer.

Verify SubjectsBar remains functionally unchanged after BottomNavigation refactor (subject switching and add/delete dialogs/toasts continue working) and ensure its container styling still works when it is the only fixed bottom bar content.

requirements.summary: Add Home/Calendar/Countdown/Notes/Tests navigation items to TasksDrawer with active-route styling and auto-close behavior on navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: TasksDrawer contains menu items for Home, Calendar, Countdown, Notes, and Tests.
Clicking any menu item navigates to the correct route and closes the drawer.
Existing Tasks section functionality (subject selector + todos CRUD) remains intact and usable.

file_operations.description: Expand TasksDrawer navigation section to include buttons for Home (/), Calendar (/calendar), Countdown (/countdown), Notes (/notes), and Tests (/tests). Use TanStack Router route state to apply an active visual style for the current route, and ensure each nav click closes the drawer before navigating. Use shadcn-ui Button/Sheet primitives already in use for consistent drawer UI; Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Adjust page layout bottom padding to match the remaining fixed SubjectsBar height so content is not obscured without leaving excessive blank space.
acceptanceCriteria: On non-customize pages, the main content has sufficient bottom padding so the last interactive content is not hidden behind the fixed Subjects bar.
No extra unused bottom padding remains that would create an unusually large blank area at the bottom of pages.

file_operations.description: Update the non-customize <main> bottom padding (currently pb-20) to a smaller value appropriate for the SubjectsBar-only fixed footer so content clears the bar without creating an oversized blank area.
